what: Lightweight Interface to the US Census Bureau API
title: Lightweight Interface to the US Census Bureau API
text: tinycensus lightweight, metadata-driven interface US Census Bureau API. designed stay small still covering broad set aggregate datasets, first-class support ACS, decennial census products, PEP, CBP, migration flows, time-series endpoints, related discovery metadata. package built around product-specific interfaces rather one generic user-facing query function. goal make common Census workflows easy without pulling large dependency stack. basic pattern : discover dataset, table, variable metadata helpers retrieve data product-specific wrapper optionally join geometry tinytiger

title: Lightweight Interface to the US Census Bureau API
text: can install development version tinycensus GitHub :
code: # install.packages("pak") pak::pak("christopherkenny/tinycensus")

title: Lightweight Interface to the US Census Bureau API
text: Discovers Census datasets live API catalog Retrieves metadata variables, tables, geographies, example queries Provides product-specific retrieval ACS, decennial census, PEP, CBP, flows, time-series datasets Searches variables retrieves encoded value metadata Accepts flexible geography inputs like "NY", "New York", "36" Returns optional sf output tinytiger

title: Lightweight Interface to the US Census Bureau API
text: main entry points : tc_get_acs() ACS products tc_get_decennial() decennial census products tc_get_pep() population estimates tc_get_cbp() County Business Patterns tc_get_pdb() Planning Database tc_get_flows() ACS migration flows tc_get_timeseries() discovery-catalog time-series endpoints metadata discovery, start tc_datasets(), tc_variables(), tc_tables(), tc_search_variables().

title: Lightweight Interface to the US Census Bureau API
text: can use many endpoints without key light exploration, Census API key recommended regular usage. write key .Renviron file future sessions, set install = TRUE supply target path explicitly: can also check whether key available:
code: tinycensus::tc_set_key("YOUR-KEY") tinycensus::tc_set_key(   "YOUR-KEY",   install = TRUE,   r_env = file.path(Sys.getenv("HOME"), ".Renviron") ) library(tinycensus)  tc_has_key() #> [1] TRUE

title: Lightweight Interface to the US Census Bureau API
text: State inputs can abbreviations, names, FIPS codes directly query interface: County normalization geography-vintage aware. means tinycensus uses county definitions implied dataset rather assuming request year alone determines valid county codes. example, ACS 2024 uses current county equivalents, decennial 2020 products keep 2020 county definitions. need override behavior specific dataset, use geography_vintage =. interface also works less-common geographies dataset supports , places, congressional districts, metropolitan areas, school districts.
code: tc_get_acs(   year = 2024,   variables = "B01001_001E",   geography = "state",   state = c("NY", "Delaware", "36") ) #> # A tibble: 2 × 4 #>   NAME     B01001_001E state GEOID #>   <chr>          <dbl> <chr> <chr> #> 1 Delaware     1021191 10    10    #> 2 New York    19852366 36    36

title: Lightweight Interface to the US Census Bureau API
text: Metadata helpers make easier explore unfamiliar datasets query . workflows, tc_tables() best place start gives compact, table-oriented view API. tc_variables() still useful want fields like universe, tc_search_variables() quickest way find likely candidates label concept.
code: tc_tables("acs/acs5", 2024)[1:5, c("name", "description")] #> # A tibble: 5 × 2 #>   name   description                                                             #>   <chr>  <chr>                                                                   #> 1 B17015 Poverty Status in the Past 12 Months of Families by Family Type by Soc… #> 2 B18104 Sex by Age by Cognitive Difficulty                                      #> 3 B17016 Poverty Status in the Past 12 Months of Families by Family Type by Wor… #> 4 B18105 Sex by Age by Ambulatory Difficulty                                     #> 5 B17017 Poverty Status in the Past 12 Months by Household Type by Age of House… vars <- tc_variables("acs/acs5", 2024) vars[   vars$name %in% c("B01001_001E", "B19013_001E"),   c("name", "label", "concept", "universe") ] #> # A tibble: 2 × 4 #>   name        label                                             concept universe #>   <chr>       <chr>                                             <chr>   <chr>    #> 1 B01001_001E Estimate!!Total:                                  Sex by… Total p… #> 2 B19013_001E Estimate!!Median household income in the past 12… Median… Househo… tc_geography("acs/acs5", 2024)[1:10, c("geography", "summary_level")] #> # A tibble: 10 × 2 #>    geography                 summary_level #>    <chr>                     <chr>         #>  1 us                        010           #>  2 region                    020           #>  3 division                  030           #>  4 state                     040           #>  5 county                    050           #>  6 county subdivision        060           #>  7 subminor civil division   067           #>  8 place/remainder (or part) 070           #>  9 tract                     140           #> 10 block group               150

title: tinycensus: Lightweight Interface to the US Census Bureau API — tinycensus-package
text: tinycensus provides lightweight, metadata-driven access US Census Bureau API. package organized around product-specific retrieval helpers tc_get_acs(), tc_get_decennial(), tc_get_pep(), tc_get_cbp(), tc_get_pdb(), tc_get_flows(), tc_get_timeseries(), rather single generic user-facing query function.

title: tinycensus: Lightweight Interface to the US Census Bureau API — tinycensus-package
text: also includes task-oriented metadata helpers discovering datasets, variables, geographies, tables, along flexible geography inputs optional geometry joins tinytiger.

title: tinycensus: Lightweight Interface to the US Census Bureau API — tinycensus-package
text: Maintainer: Christopher T. Kenny ctkenny@proton.(ORCID)

title: tinycensus 0.0.0.9000
text: Initial development release. Added generic Census API access census_get(). Added dataset discovery helpers datasets, variables, groups, geographies, examples. Added convenience wrappers ACS, decennial census, population estimates, county business patterns, time-series datasets. Added flexible geography inputs, including state names, abbreviations, FIPS codes, county normalization helpers. Added optional spatial output tinytiger. Added testthat vcr test coverage metadata, tabular queries, input normalization, geometry workflows.
